title: Dot Opera treatment
description: One file per opera, docs/treatments/<id>.json. Written in Iain's order: acts, then what happens and the feeling, then how the toolset makes it, then three versions and a pick. The opera itself is code (operas/<id>.js); this is what the code must deliver.

lang.description: The opera's language. Every caption is in it.

tune.description: The most recognisable tune, quoted. Scale degrees in k.deg notation.

fromMemory.description: True until Iain has checked it by ear

motifs.description: Other quoted themes (a fate motif, a march)

colours.description: Staging colours with their source, plus at most three story colours, each meaning one thing.

source.description: Where audiences know it from (costume, set, lighting)

characters.description: Each one is a single dot.

name.description: In the opera's language; also the act's caption

feeling.description: What the audience should feel, in a few words

set.description: The place, as light: the crowd, the colour of the world

characters.description: Who's on stage, where, and who's lit

actions.description: What moves, and the shots: wide, mid, close

music.description: Which theme, which voice, tempo, silence

emotion.description: How the pieces add up to the feeling

captions.description: Small tags beside dots, in the opera's language

wink.description: The deadpan comic beat, if this act has one (one or two per opera)

chosen.description: Label of the version Iain picked

notes.description: Refinements from review, frame by frame
